feedback.problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
$B=[\begin{aligned}-9 & 9 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & -8 \\ -2 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,B-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
B-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}-9-\lambda  & 9 & 0 \\ 0 & 5-\lambda  & -8 \\ -2 & 1 & -\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

The characteristic equation is $det(B-\lambda I)=0.$ 

Expanding the determinant across the $1$st row, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(B-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}-9-\lambda  & 9 & 0 \\ 0 & 5-\lambda  & -8 \\ -2 & 1 & -\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-9-\lambda )|\begin{aligned}5-\lambda  & -8 \\ 1 & -\lambda \end{aligned}|-9|\begin{aligned}0 & -8 \\ -2 & -\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-9-\lambda )({\lambda }^{2}-5\lambda +8)-9(-16) & =0 \\ (-{\lambda }^{3}-4{\lambda }^{2}+37\lambda -72)+144 & =0 \\ -{\lambda }^{3}-4{\lambda }^{2}+37\lambda +72 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{3}+4{\lambda }^{2}-37\lambda -72 & =0\end{aligned}
$$
